thought.text: Excellent! The API, schema, and admin all work. The app root returns 303 (redirect to login, expected). Let me test QGIS and app login flow.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== qgis GetCapabilities ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities"
echo "=== app redirect location ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -D - -o /dev/null https://app.localhost/ | grep -i location
echo "=== api admin blocked on api domain ==="; docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.localhost/admin/
